thread_text:
Molly (PM): Heads-up — quick status check on pricing/packaging rollout dependencies. We have three live blockers for launch: contract ceilings (hard vs soft), quota enforcement hook, and billing export schema. Target launch 2026-04-08. Who owns what and current ETA?

Samir - Billing: I own the billing export schema. PR #1287 is open but needs runtime review. Current export is daily aggregates per-tenant. Question: do we need per-invocation traces for audit/chargeback, or are aggregates sufficient? :thinking:

Alex T (Eng-runtime): I can review PR 1287 today. Per-invocation traces will add ~2-3x payload and cost; recommend aggregates by default and a toggle for trace-level exports if legal requires them. Link me the PR and sample payload. :eyes:

Prajay (Metering): Quota enforcement hook is on my plate. Blocked by ambiguity in the contracts change around carryover quotas and grace periods — need exact spec from product/contracts. Current branch: feature/quota-enforce.

Molly (PM): Contracts asked for a 'ceiling' field that can be soft (warning) or hard (block). Example pattern they want: {"ceiling": {"type":"hard","limit":100000}}. Also need rules for prorated tiers on mid-cycle plan changes. Can Contracts confirm enum and behavior?

Samir - Billing: If ceiling.type == "hard" we need a billing-driven ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED event and an API to mark account suspended so downstream systems (ingest/export) can handle it. Billing export should include suspension events.

Chris Eng: Tagging @alex-t and @izzy for runtime + observability review. Also will add unit tests for the quota enforcement hook in the eng-test harness. ETA for tests: Thu.

Izzy (Observability): I will add metrics quota.block.count and quota.warn.count and a canary dashboard. ETA Friday. Also will create an alert for sudden spike in quota.warn that might indicate a bad rollout.

Legal-Bot: Reminder: Contracts require archival of billing events for 7 years in EU. Please confirm retention path + encryption standards.

Security: For Private/Dedicated customers we need a KMS flow. Customers can provide a KMS key alias; otherwise Redwood KMS is used. I'll add a checklist for Private deployments (KMS, audit logs, retention).

Alex T (Eng-runtime): Quick summary of action items I have: 1) Review billing PR 1287 (Samir) — aiming EOD. 2) Wire ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED event into ingestion pipeline (feature branch created). 3) Add optional trace flag if legal asks. 4) Coordinate with Izzy on metrics tags.

Molly (PM): I'll consolidate the contract schema request and ask Contracts to deliver exact JSON keys (ceiling type, limit, enforcement policy, prorate rules) by tomorrow noon. If Contracts can't, we risk delaying canary. :warning:

Samir - Billing: Sample export payload (for reviewers):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "date": "2026-04-01",
  "tokens": 12345,
  "events": [ { "type": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED", "reason": "ceiling_hard", "ts": 1710000000 } ]
}
```

Alex T (Eng-runtime): Thanks — I'll wire that into the ingest mapping. Quick question: do we want model-version-level metering now, or postpone? Model-level will increase cardinality and cost.

Prajay (Metering): Initial rollout should be account-level only. Model-level metering is a follow-up (Q2 item).

Chris Eng: Can folks paste PR links in this thread so reviewers can triage?

Samir - Billing: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1287, https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/1290 (quota hook), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1302 (ingest mapping).

Izzy (Observability): I'll add dashboards + an alert runbook and post the URL once ready.

Security: Also note — for EU customers we may need to route exports to customer-specified storage endpoints; documenting options now.

Molly (PM): If we clear these blockers by EOD, plan is to lock branches and start a canary on Monday. Please ping me directly for urgent items. Closing this async sync — thanks all. :thumbsup:

Alex T (Eng-runtime): :party_parrot: Will ping once PR review is done.

Samir - Billing: Marking follow-ups: confirm archival path with Security, add ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED to schema docs, and add sample events to billing README.

Prajay (Metering): Will open a small doc for carryover/proration examples and link it here when ready.

Molly (PM): Follow-ups tracked in the product board; I'll create dependencies for Billing, Metering, Runtime and Security. Expect a short checkpoint tomorrow.
